About us

Our history

Three generations of master plumbers. From a single van in 1998 to a full-service company trusted by thousands across Los Angeles.

25+
Years in business
18K+
Jobs completed
40+
Technicians
4.9
Average rating
  1. 1998

    The First Van

    Founder Marcus Reyes launches GlobalFixs with a single van, a master plumber's license, and a promise to fix it right the first time.

  2. 2005

    10,000th Job Completed

    Word of mouth grows the business. We complete our 10,000th service call and hire our first dedicated dispatch team.

  3. 2012

    Expanding to HVAC

    After years of customer requests, we add heating and cooling services, becoming a full-service home comfort company.

  4. 2018

    Second Generation Joins

    Marcus's son joins as operations lead, bringing modern technology and smart dispatch systems to the family business.

  5. 2024

    18,000+ Homes Served

    Today, GlobalFixs is one of the most trusted names in Greater Los Angeles, serving over 18,000 homes.
